input.quote: (a) At any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding, either party may terminate this Agreement for any or no reason upon fifteen (15) days advance notice to the other.
input.rationale: The Agreement runs indefinitely (§2: until terminated under §6), but the only convenience right in §6(a) is available solely "At any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding." Because the commercial substance sits in SOWs, we have no ability to exit an in-flight engagement for convenience at all — that fails even the fallback (Customer termination on 60–90 days' notice), and there is no refund mechanic for prepaid amounts. The Vendor side is already at the preferred position (Contractor cannot terminate for convenience while an SOW is outstanding), so we left the mutual 15-day no-SOW right intact and made the smallest edit: adding a Company right to terminate the Agreement or any SOW on 30 days' notice with a refund of prepaid fees for Services not performed. No early-termination fee or acceleration exists, and §6(b) already limits Contractor's payment on termination to fees incurred through the termination date.

proposal.summary: Add a Company convenience-termination right over the Agreement and any SOW on 30 days' notice with refund of prepaid amounts.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 6(a) only permits convenience termination when no Statement of Work is outstanding, so we would be locked into every in-flight engagement; we have added our standard right to exit the Agreement or any SOW on 30 days' notice with a refund of prepaid amounts, with Contractor still paid for Services performed through termination.

ops.newText: either party may terminate this Agreement for any or no reason upon fifteen (15) days advance notice to the other. In addition, Company may terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience, in whole or in part, at any time upon thirty (30) days advance written notice to Contractor, in which case Contractor shall refund any prepaid fees for Services not performed as of the effective date of termination.
